content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Overview
Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Visakhapatnam Port Authority has announced a total of 20 Trade Apprentice placements across different ITI trades. The vacancy details are given below: The notification mentions a total of 20 Apprentice placements with a training period of one year for each trade.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates can submit their online applications through the Apprenticeship India portal from 24 August 2026. The last date for applying is 23 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a recognised institute. The trade-wise qualification requirements are as follows: Welder - Passed ITI in Welder trade. Electrician - Passed ITI in Electrician trade. Fitter - Passed ITI in Fitter trade. Motor Mechanic - Passed ITI in Motor Mechanic (Motor Vehicle) trade. Electronics - Passed ITI in Electronics (Mechanic) trade. The trade-wise qualification details are provided in the official notification table. Candidates should have completed a minimum age of 14 years as on 31 August 2026.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Salary / Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend details are mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The engagement of Trade Apprentices will be made purely on the basis of merit. Selection will be based on the aggregate marks obtained by candidates in ITI. Merit-based selection according to ITI marks. Shortlisted candidates will be called for certificate verification. Trade allotment will be decided by the Head of Department. The selection criteria and certificate verification process are mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Application
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the required documents ready while applying through the Apprenticeship India portal. ITI qualification details and certificates Educational documents Other required documents as applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the Apprenticeship India portal. Register on the NAPS Apprentice Portal. Search for Apprentice Opportunity. Select the designated trade course type. Select location as Andhra Pradesh. Search establishment as "Visakhapatnam Port Authority". Click on Apply and complete the application process. The application procedure is mentioned in the official notification, including registration on the NAPS Apprentice Portal and selecting Visakhapatnam Port Authority as the establishment.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Candidates
content_sections.text: TA and DA will not be provided for attending certificate verification. No boarding or lodging expenses will be provided. Completion of apprenticeship training does not guarantee employment in Visakhapatnam Port Authority. The notification clearly states that candidates will not receive TA/DA for certificate verification and VPA is not liable to provide employment after completion of apprenticeship training.
